"""Security-surface probe: boundary evidence across kinds and scopes.

Carriers, by design:

* import evidence at MODULE scope (``pickle`` / ``subprocess``);
* call evidence at MODULE scope (the boot ``subprocess.run``);
* builtin evidence inside a callable, including TWO distinct evidence
  symbols on ONE line (``eval`` + ``compile``) — the datum that proves
  ``evidence_symbol`` is a key component, not display payload;
* one evidence symbol on two lines of one callable (``pickle.loads``) —
  the datum that proves ``start_line`` is a key component;
* call evidence inside a class body and inside a method.
"""

import pickle
import subprocess

_BOOT = subprocess.run(["true"], check=False)


def run_dynamic(source: str) -> object:
    return eval(compile(source, "<probe>", "eval"))


def decode_blob(blob: bytes) -> tuple[object, object]:
    first = pickle.loads(blob)
    second = pickle.loads(blob)
    return (first, second)


class ShellHelper:
    BANNER = subprocess.check_output(["true"])

    def sweep(self) -> int:
        return subprocess.check_call(["true"])


_PROBE = (run_dynamic("1"), decode_blob(b"x"), ShellHelper().sweep())
